subtitle: Jimin has a bidirectional circular queue containing N elements. Jimin wants to extract several elements from this queue. Jimin can perform the following three operations on this queue. The number N originally contained in the queue is given. Also, the positions of the elements Jimin wants to extract are given (these positions refer to the original position in the queue). Write a program that outputs the minimum number of operations 2 and 3 required to extract those elements in the given order.
